schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).
compiler: ccv0 (2026-11-23, with shrink.sh and the options: 314 of 390 functions exact)
binary: /bin/ex (links: vi, view, edit); E711, text 63488 bytes (code to 0xf7fe)
build: vi.mk of Plexus: mkstr - ex2.13strings x FILE.c, cc -E | xstr -c -, cc -c x.c. WEGA adds a step between the compiler and cas (src/cmd/ex/shrink.sh, cc -S, shrink.sh x.s, cas), both parts to save room (the code ends at 0xf7fe, the text limit is 64K): (1) each module begins with a table of 'jp _name' for every external function called 3 times or more (callr) in the module, the calls go by calr to the table; order 'sort | uniq -c | sort -n' (by the number of calls, then the name, ASCII); 22 tables, 183 stubs, 944 calls, 1156 bytes saved; only in ex (all programs of the root scanned). (2) a frame operand at offset 0 becomes @fp: ~L1(fp) in a function with '~L1 := 0' (not lda), and 0(fp) beside r0..r7 (the parameter stores); the saves of r8..r14 stay 0(fp) (139 of 139). Measured on the ccv0 output of all modules: 98 of 98 parameter stores and about 220 operands in the bodies as in the original. Of 310 files of the root only ex (and its links) has saves at 0(r15) with parameters at @r15. Not documented.
open: setjmp.h missing in WEGA (measured with setret.h, ret_buf).
options: -DZCMD -DZZCMD -DRDONLY -DWRAPMGN -DOPENCODE -DLISPCODE -DTAGSCODE -DCRNL -DSOFTTABS -DCHDIR, not -DUSG3TTY (the V7 tty calls, not those of System III as in vi.mk of Plexus). Measured 2026-11-23 on all modules (ccv0, shrink.sh), the sum of the differing lines: vi.mk options 2757; + OPENCODE, LISPCODE, TAGSCODE, CRNL 2455; + SOFTTABS 2421; without USG3TTY 2248; + CHDIR 900 (314 of 390 functions exact). Each of them taken out again makes it worse; UCVISUAL (945) and BEEHIVE (902) not.
tty: sTTY: the original calls stty(i, &tty), not ioctl(i, TIOCSETN, &tty) as the Plexus source under #ifdef TIOCSETN does (sgtty.h of WEGA defines TIOCSETN): ex_put.c calls stty there (2026-11-23).

reload.difference: the original reloads a parameter from its frame home (ld r7,@r15) in front of its first use, ccv0 takes it from the register
reload.tried: on tail without effect: no blank line, char comm[], return (...), return; at the end, a block, a null statement, an extra local, the parameter undeclared
reload.findings: an unused label in front of the statement gives it (OLD_D3K forgets the parameters at a label no jump names; putchar and tail exact with it); thirteen unused labels are no likely source form

indirect call.difference: indirect call (order(f, INTEMP), ld r1,0(fp); call @r1, local3.c gencall): the store of the function address to the temporary stays 0(r15) in the original, the load into r1 is @r15 in vgotab and the second pair of listchar, 0(r15) in the first
indirect call.findings: no text rule of shrink.sh gives it: two pairs with the same text in the .s come out differently

structure copy register.difference: nttyc = ottyc: the destination goes to r0 (ld r0,#nttyc) and is copied into an address register for ldir: r4 (setty), r6 (gTTY) in the original, r1 with ccv0
structure copy register.findings: of all files of the root only ex has r4/r6 there (adb, vls: r1; dumpdir, restor: r7); none of the exact v0 programs has the pattern; the tree is the same (ld r0,#.. in both)
